label: Audit event (Sync Gateway)
type: a single recorded occurrence in sgw:audit-logging - ~50 distinct event ids (53000-55999 range) across Auditing, Sync Gateway, Database, User/Role Administration, Replication and Document categories, each carrying a default-enabled flag, a filterable flag, and an EventScope (Global vs. Database).
note: Shares no actual vocabulary with Server's security:auditing audit_event catalogue (different id ranges, different category names) despite the same general shape (filterable, per-node, timestamped, immutable, Admin/Data/User-type split). No page states an equivalence between the two catalogues.
